reviewMethod: Every actual LibreOffice Word PDF page and Chromium Japanese/English print page was opened and inspected by Codex reviewers; diagnostics and source/image hashes were also checked.

wordTextPreservation.resolution: Both complete source paragraphs span page boundaries interrupted by repeated header/footer text; every raw diagnostic miss was checked in actual PDF text and full page images.

layoutObservations: Some retained UI screenshots intentionally show scroll viewports or partial peripheral controls; dense graph labels overlap. Captions and required procedural evidence remain readable. Individual screenshot text is not universally complete.
Some table captions and headers occur at a page end with complete body rows under repeated headers on the following page. Some closing reference pages are sparse but have intact content.
The field-free headings-navigation edition deliberately omits PAGE fields and cached page numbers; the bare Page footer label is cosmetic. Twenty-nine chapter/appendix links provide navigation.

earlierParticipantV1FailedChecks.scope: Two print-validator blank-page checks flagged terminal-reference-only overflow pages (Japanese page 64, English page 70); these pages were not literally empty.
earlierParticipantV1FailedChecks.correction: Extended the six existing chapter-specific compact print selectors from chapters 7/15 to include 19/22, keeping terminal references with preceding content while preserving font sizes. No pages or source text were removed. Fresh v2 validation has 152 PASS and 0 FAIL.

note: Visual and structural document checks do not establish AI answer accuracy or acceptance of all Fabric features.
